# convex_log_stream (Resource)

Streams a Convex deployment's log events to an external destination, through the [Deployment Platform API](https://docs.convex.dev/deployment-platform-api).

~> **Log streams require a Convex Pro plan.** On other plans the API rejects the request.

Exactly one sink block must be set. Switching to a different sink replaces the stream, since Convex cannot convert one in place.

Convex starts a stream asynchronously, so `status` is usually `pending` right after the first apply and becomes `active` on a later refresh. A stream that cannot start reports `failed` together with a `status_reason`.

Credentials such as `api_key` and `dsn` are never returned by the API, so they are kept from configuration and cannot be checked against the remote value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "convex_project" "app" {
  team_id = var.convex_team_id
  name    = "My Application"
}

resource "convex_deployment" "prod" {
  project_id      = convex_project.app.id
  deployment_type = "prod"
  is_default      = true
}

# Log streams require a Convex Pro plan.
#
# Exactly one sink block per resource. Declare several resources to send the
# same deployment's events to more than one destination.

resource "convex_log_stream" "axiom" {
  deployment_url = convex_deployment.prod.deployment_url

  axiom {
    api_key      = var.axiom_api_key
    dataset_name = "convex"

    # Extra fields attached to every event.
    attributes = {
      env     = "production"
      service = "api"
    }

    # Omit topics to receive everything, including topics Convex adds later.
    topics = ["console", "function_execution", "exception"]
  }
}

resource "convex_log_stream" "datadog" {
  deployment_url = convex_deployment.prod.deployment_url

  datadog {
    site_location = "EU"
    api_key       = var.datadog_api_key
    service       = "convex-api"
    tags          = ["team:core", "env:production"]
  }
}

# Convex generates the HMAC secret and returns it once, at creation. Use it to
# verify that incoming requests really came from Convex.
resource "convex_log_stream" "webhook" {
  deployment_url = convex_deployment.prod.deployment_url

  webhook {
    url    = "https://example.com/convex-logs"
    format = "jsonl"
  }
}

resource "convex_log_stream" "sentry" {
  deployment_url = convex_deployment.prod.deployment_url

  sentry {
    dsn = var.sentry_dsn

    tags = {
      env = "production"
    }
  }
}

output "webhook_hmac_secret" {
  value     = convex_log_stream.webhook.webhook.hmac_secret
  sensitive = true
}

# Asynchronous: usually "pending" right after the first apply, then "active".
output "axiom_status" {
  value = convex_log_stream.axiom.status
}

variable "axiom_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "datadog_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "sentry_dsn" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_url` (String) Backend URL of the deployment, as reported by `convex_deployment.deployment_url`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `axiom` (Block, Optional) Stream to an Axiom dataset. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--axiom))
- `datadog` (Block, Optional) Stream to Datadog. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--datadog))
- `posthog_error_tracking` (Block, Optional) Route exceptions to PostHog error tracking. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--posthog_error_tracking))
- `posthog_logs` (Block, Optional) Stream logs to PostHog. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--posthog_logs))
- `sentry` (Block, Optional) Route exceptions to Sentry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--sentry))
- `webhook` (Block, Optional) Stream to an arbitrary URL by POST. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--webhook))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier Convex assigned to the log stream.
- `status` (String) Current state: `pending`, `restarting`, `active`, `failed` or `deleting`. Set by Convex, so it changes outside Terraform.
- `status_reason` (String) Why the stream failed, when `status` is `failed`. Null otherwise.

<a id="nestedblock--axiom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `axiom`

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Axiom API key. Never returned by the API, so it is kept from configuration and stored in Terraform state.
- `attributes` (Map of String) Extra key/value fields attached to every event sent to Axiom.
- `dataset_name` (String) Axiom dataset that receives the events.
- `ingest_url` (String) Override for Axiom's ingest endpoint.
- `topics` (List of String) Event topics to subscribe to. Omit to receive all topics, including ones Convex adds later. One or more of: `verification`, `console`, `function_execution`, `exception`, `audit_log`, `scheduler_stats`, `scheduled_job_lag`, `current_storage_usage`, `concurrency_stats`, `storage_api_bandwidth`, `log_stream_egress`, `custom_audit`.


<a id="nestedblock--datadog"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datadog`

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Datadog API key. Never returned by the API, so it is kept from configuration and stored in Terraform state.
- `service` (String) Value for Datadog's `service` field.
- `site_location` (String) Datadog site the logs are sent to. One of `US1`, `US3`, `US5`, `EU`, `US1_FED`, `AP1`.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags sent with every event via Datadog's `ddtags` field.
- `topics` (List of String) Event topics to subscribe to. Omit to receive all topics, including ones Convex adds later. One or more of: `verification`, `console`, `function_execution`, `exception`, `audit_log`, `scheduler_stats`, `scheduled_job_lag`, `current_storage_usage`, `concurrency_stats`, `storage_api_bandwidth`, `log_stream_egress`, `custom_audit`.


<a id="nestedblock--posthog_error_tracking"></a>
### Nested Schema for `posthog_error_tracking`

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) PostHog project API key. Never returned by the API, so it is kept from configuration and stored in Terraform state.
- `host` (String) PostHog host, for self-hosted or non-default regions.


<a id="nestedblock--posthog_logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `posthog_logs`

Optional:

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) PostHog project API key. Never returned by the API, so it is kept from configuration and stored in Terraform state.
- `host` (String) PostHog host, for self-hosted or non-default regions.
- `service_name` (String) Service name reported with each event.
- `topics` (List of String) Event topics to subscribe to. Omit to receive all topics, including ones Convex adds later. One or more of: `verification`, `console`, `function_execution`, `exception`, `audit_log`, `scheduler_stats`, `scheduled_job_lag`, `current_storage_usage`, `concurrency_stats`, `storage_api_bandwidth`, `log_stream_egress`, `custom_audit`.


<a id="nestedblock--sentry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sentry`

Optional:

- `dsn` (String, Sensitive) Sentry DSN. Never returned by the API, so it is kept from configuration and stored in Terraform state.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags added to every event routed to Sentry.


<a id="nestedblock--webhook"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhook`

Optional:

- `format` (String) Payload encoding, `json` or `jsonl`.
- `topics` (List of String) Event topics to subscribe to. Omit to receive all topics, including ones Convex adds later. One or more of: `verification`, `console`, `function_execution`, `exception`, `audit_log`, `scheduler_stats`, `scheduled_job_lag`, `current_storage_usage`, `concurrency_stats`, `storage_api_bandwidth`, `log_stream_egress`, `custom_audit`.
- `url` (String) URL that receives the POST requests.

Read-Only:

- `hmac_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret Convex signs each request with, so the receiver can verify the payload. Generated at creation and stored in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Log streams are imported as "<deployment_url>/<log_stream_id>". The URL
# contains slashes, so the id is taken as the final segment.
#
# Credentials (api_key, dsn) are never returned by Convex, so they are empty
# after import -- add them to configuration to match what the stream was
# created with.
terraform import convex_log_stream.axiom 'https://playful-otter-123.convex.cloud/abc123'
```
